rationale: Do not apply the earlier conceptual-portfolio merge recommendation. INPP's current official case study presents Durham Region Court House as a distinct operational investment, reports 100% equity ownership, a March 2007 financial close and a 30-year term from construction completion. Amber's current project case study reports the same project-level ownership and operating status. Infrastructure Ontario separately identifies Access Justice Durham as the winning DBFM consortium and confirms construction completion in 2009. INPP is the investment vehicle, not an operating platform into which this standalone project should be merged.

acquisitionExitCheck.acquisitionSearch: Babcock & Brown Public Partnerships, INPP's predecessor, announced the acquisition of 100% of the equity in the Durham project company at financial close on March 2, 2007.
acquisitionExitCheck.exitSearch: No sale or divestiture was found. Current INPP and Amber project pages both identify the asset as operational and report 100% equity ownership.
acquisitionExitCheck.currentProjectStatus: Operational under a 30-year term following construction completion, with INPP reporting 100% equity ownership.
